title: Chapter 308
text:
Han Xiao raised his eyebrows. "This theory has been proven as well?"

"Not really."

Kerlodd flicked his ponytail. "They believe in the existence of a creator or a great being. Similar theories involve theology, and they can't avoid the Arcane Church, one of the three Universal Civilizations. Their system is based on spirit and mystery, and they believe that there is an indescribable great being. This is the source of their belief and power …"

"Stop, I know what the Arcane Church is like," Han Xiao interrupted.

"Alright, where were we … Oh, the theories are different, but they all extend to countless technologies and applications. Therefore, these theories and knowledge systems are just tools to understand the world. There are differences in whether the tools are useful or not, and there are differences in difficulty in using them. The right tool does the right job, but there is no universal tool, which means that there is no theory that can be applied to all phenomena. The results of every 'tool' are different.

For example, our Godora's Cornerstone Theory believes that all particles are magical factors. Our history started with magic, but as we progressed, we realized that technology was not bad, so we started to study it as well. These two systems are just tools to help us understand the world. "

Han Xiao frowned. "You know quite a lot."

"Haha, I'm a trained investigator after all. I've heard other races bragging in various space stations, so I know a little bit about all kinds of things."

Kerlodd grinned. "All in all, unsolved mysteries are called Space Wonders, and there is a very small chance that the Inhumans are one."

Space Wonders, huh …

Han Xiao made a mental note of it.

At this time, a tsunami of cheers came from the direction of the arena.

Han Xiaoxin opened the forums, and a sensational video was being played. The audience was cheering like a tsunami. The result of the last battle was out, and the champion was born!

In the team competition, Dynasty won the division by a small margin. Long Sky was the runner-up, and Temple of God was the runner-up. The three powerhouses did not fall behind and took the top three. The other clubs that made it to the top eight also did well. The King and Noble Generals triumphantly won the individual competition, winning two yolks for the Imperial Court. Their glory was limitless, and the Imperial Court's reputation was unparalleled.

Mad Blade defeated another semi-finalist and won third place. He was a new face and was known as the biggest dark horse of the tournament.

The Blue Star Division's top three teams and individuals had all received invitations to the International Regular Season. The three teams were all Chinese clubs, and countless players were looking forward to the Chinese clubs competing with the other divisions to obtain good results in the International Regular Season. The atmosphere on the forum was very lively. It was as if they were celebrating a festival. Dynasty was the most popular.

The Division Finals came to an end. There was still a year of preparation before the International Regular Season. The Pro League was considered to have come to an end, but the excitement of the players had yet to subside.

Countless posts were analyzing their opponents in the other divisions and giving suggestions to their own teams, cheering them on. The clubs that had achieved good results also held press conferences to promote their teams. It was bustling with noise and excitement.

"It's finally over. Those pro players are finally free." Han Xiao's eyes sparkled as he prepared to carry out his plan to bring the players away.

…

Shelter Square.

The players coming and going were still immersed in the excitement of the Pro League, discussing their idols. Occasionally, a pro player would appear to gain popularity, attracting onlookers from time to time.

Of course, there was also a group of African brothers who firmly believed in their European heritage. When it was time, they would wait at the spot where Han Xiao usually appeared, eagerly waiting for a new batch of boxes.

"It's coming, it's coming." The old brothers stretched their necks.

The truck drove over from afar. Han Xiao stopped the truck and walked down. He did not sell boxes like he usually did. He looked around and suddenly said, "I have a difficult mission that requires helpers. Select qualified members to follow me on an adventure. If you are confident, you can accept my test. Only those who pass will be qualified to become my teammate."

Immediately, Han Xiao released the mission that he had prepared beforehand.

[Team Selection]

Mission Introduction: Han Xiao is about to secretly leave Blue Star and embark on a new adventure. He needs to select strong members to be his teammates. Those who succeed can follow him to the stars.

Mission Acceptance Requirement: LV60

Mission Time Limit: 5 days

Requirements: Pass Han Xiao's Combat Test.

Reward: 1 EXP and the qualification to follow Han Xiao.

A stone stirred up a thousand ripples!

The players' eyes widened, and they were in an uproar.

"This is too sudden. We can leave the novice planet?"

"You actually need to be at max level to accept the mission. How infuriating!"

To this day, all the players' activities were limited to the novice planet. No one had ever entered the stars. When Han Xiao released this news, it immediately caused a sensation. This group of brothers fought to be the first to post and show off on the forums. The entire Blue Star section was in an uproar, and even players from other planets were looking at the posts.

The forums were in an uproar!

The players' attention was forcefully pulled away from the Pro League by Han Xiao, and all of them were focused on this shocking mission.

The stars were a mysterious place to all the players, and they were full of curiosity and anticipation. They were trapped on their planets and could only see the big picture. Now, they had a chance to come into contact with the stars that would only open in the later versions. The players were shocked at first, but their hearts were burning with excitement.

This was an opportunity!

If they could follow Han Xiao, they would be able to enter the star environment earlier than most people. This was definitely a huge advantage.

Han Xiao had casually thrown out such a huge mission, and it was like a clap of thunder. The players realized that Han Xiao's words were vague, and he was deliberately hiding the details of the mission. However, the mission introduction revealed that he was going to enter the stars. The players couldn't help but feel a sense of joy. They thought that even if Han Xiao didn't say anything, the mission would still faithfully describe Han Xiao's secret plans.

Han Xiao deliberately did this because he wanted this news to circulate among the players, and it would make the players feel a sense of joy, thinking that his true intentions were exposed by the interface. When the players felt a sense of superiority, the hidden Han Technician smiled as he watched all of this happen.

He naturally needed a reason to bring along the pro players, and he couldn't make it too obvious. Thus, he used the method of issuing the selection mission. First, he used the max level requirement to eliminate a large number of casual players. After narrowing down the range, there was a lot of room for manipulation in the combat test. Whether or not the players could last more than thirty seconds completely depended on how much strength they displayed.

After some manipulation, he could accurately select the pro players he wanted.

The news quickly attracted the attention of the pro players. After the Pro League, these players had a year of rest to continue improving themselves. However, because they were at the max level, they could only train their skills and find some new skills. All the teams in the division had similar conditions, but this time, Han Xiao brought them the opportunity to open a new map.

A new map meant countless new opportunities!

These players were overjoyed. In their eyes, this was a blessing from heaven. No one would miss this opportunity.

…

The next day, countless pro players gathered. They were like celebrities walking the red carpet, shining brightly. Especially now that they were wearing the halo of the Pro League results, they looked even grander. Many veteran players in the sanctuary felt a sense of familiarity.

"Right, a long time ago, when Black Phantom first started selling class advancement knowledge, the scene was similar to this."

"There are still videos of that time on the forums. The scene now is much bigger than before. Almost all the pro players are here."

"Both times, it was related to Black Phantom …"

The Pro League had just ended, and the players were still in the sanctuary. This was one of the reasons why Han Xiao wanted to start the selection at this time.

Very soon, a large group of people accepted the mission. Han Xiao opened up some distance, randomly selected a pro player that he did not have any impression of, and said, "Hold on for thirty seconds and you pass the test."

Almost a thousand people accepted the mission. Hearing this, they could not help but look at each other.

"Thirty seconds shouldn't be too difficult, right?" Second Prince said. "Even if I were to solo a level 60 beast boss, I could hold on for a few minutes."

Li Ge looked at the time, shook his head, and said, "Thirty seconds per person is too long."

As they were chatting, the pro players and max level players all used [Detect] on Han Xiao and obtained some basic information.

Han Xiao -? (Green Name)

Level:?

Attribute:?

Danger Level: Extremely Fatal

"All question marks?!" Everyone's expression changed slightly, and they were shocked.

They had reached the max level in Version 1.0, and when they used [Detect] on other level 60 boss-level NPCs, they could at least see the level and some basic attributes of the other party. However, Han Xiao's information was still full of question marks. Even his most basic identity was also a question mark. This would only happen if he was at least five levels higher than them.

Ever since they had reached the max level, they had not encountered any other example like this!
